name: Unquiet Grey
source:
You wake up by the side of the road, alone and freezing. A stranger’s jacket covers you. 

You don’t recognise it. You don’t recognise the man it belongs to either, staring out from the ID card you find in the pockets.

So why is there a picture of him and [i]you[/i] on his phone screen?

[From [url=https://endysis.itch.io/unquiet-grey]itch.io[/url]]
